title: upgrade attention kernels: flashattentionv2 + fused rope ops + scheduling improvements
description: Motivation: improve serving throughput and tail latency for common generation workloads by upgrading attention kernels to FlashAttention v2, introducing fused rotary/ROPE ops, and wiring scheduler + KV-cache paths to take advantage of fused kernels. This PR is a bundle of kernel upgrades, runtime wiring, and perf tests. Changes are backwards-compatible by default and gated behind runtime flags; rollout is configured as a canary in Dedicated. Highlights: 1) integrate FlashAttention v2 kernels with fused QKV+softmax path; 2) implement fused rotary embedding (rope) ops to avoid extra memory passes for rotary/rotary_nd and support both interleaved and non-interleaved weights; 3) add scheduling heuristics to continuous batching to prefer fused-kernel-friendly batch shapes; 4) optimize KV-cache shard reads/writes to avoid copies when using fused ops; 5) add perf benchmarks and regression tests. Checklist: - [x] Kernel integration and unit tests - [x] Runtime wiring + feature flag - [x] Scheduler heuristic for batch steering - [x] KV-cache zero-copy path when safe - [x] Benchmark scripts and results - [x] Docs and release notes Rollout plan: merged to main, enable flag=false by default, enable for Dedicated canary region, monitor token/sec and p99 latency, rollback by flipping feature flag or reverting kernel selection. Related Linear: ENG-4812, ENG-4799.
author: Nora Kim
release_notes: Performance: ~12-25% throughput improvements and 10-30% p99 latency reduction for medium/long context gen workloads when fused kernels are enabled. Added runtime feature flag to opt-in; no behavioral changes expected when flag is off.

performance_summary: Internal bench (batch=8, seq=128, model=resnet-style-attn-proxy): +18% tokens/sec; seq=1024 workloads saw +12% throughput but 25% p99 improvement in tail when combined with scheduler steering. Memory use: fused rope reduces extra temporary allocation by ~30% in hot paths.
test_plan: Unit tests for kernels, CI perf smoke checks, canary rollout in Dedicated region; monitor token/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency, and error rates. If regression observed revert feature flag. Documented rollback steps.
notes: Customers using custom kernels should be unaffected; kernel selection is per-device and can be overridden. No model weight changes required.
